name: Zabbud
overview: Zabbud is a male biblical figure identified as a descendant of Bigvai. He is noted for having participated in the return to Jerusalem with Ezra, as recorded in Ezra 8:14. Beyond this, the biblical record provides limited additional details about his background or tribal affiliation.
namesAndTitles: The name Zabbud means '[he has] bestowed upon.' This proper name, mentioned in Ezra 8:14, does not appear to have been given directly by God but reflects a meaningful Hebrew designation.
familyAndRelationships: Zabbud is explicitly described as a descendant of Bigvai, establishing a direct familial link. Scripture does not provide further information about his family or other relationships beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Zabbud's significance lies in his role as one of the individuals who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra, marking him as part of the faithful remnant restoring the community after exile. His lineage from Bigvai situates him within a known family group involved in this important biblical event. Though not extensively detailed, his mention underscores the collective effort in reestablishing worship and order in Jerusalem under Ezra's leadership.
